summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue of `ax.bar` raising an exception for all-nan data, but it may introduce unintended behavior for other cases.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of `_safe_first_finite` to return `np.nan` when no finite values are found, which could have unforeseen consequences in other parts of the codebase that rely on this function.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or affect other functionalities.
